records.source: It sends only what :func:`_hosted_request` keeps, the anonymised error summary and the question, to the relay's ``/diagnose`` route through :func:`spacr.crashreport.diagnose_remotely`. The answer is generated advice and is labelled as such. It is the provider used when no vendor CLI is installed and signed in (:func:`default_provider`), and it is unavailable when the network is forbidden (:func:`spacr.crashreport.network_allowed`).
records.context: It sends only what :func:`_hosted_request` keeps, the anonymised error summary and the question, to the relay's ``/diagnose`` route through :func:`spacr.crashreport.diagnose_remotely`. The answer is generated advice and is labelled as such. It is the provider used when no vendor CLI is installed and signed in (:func:`default_provider`), and it is unavailable when the network is forbidden (:func:`spacr.crashreport.network_allowed`).
records.translation: Solo envía lo que conserva :func:`_hosted_request`, el resumen anonimizado del error y la pregunta, a la ruta ``/diagnose`` del servicio de retransmisión mediante :func:`spacr.crashreport.diagnose_remotely`. La respuesta es un consejo generado y se etiqueta como tal. Es el proveedor utilizado cuando ninguna CLI de proveedor está instalada y tiene una sesión iniciada (:func:`default_provider`), y no está disponible cuando se prohíbe el acceso a la red (:func:`spacr.crashreport.network_allowed`).
